## Load in Libraries and Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: hide

# Load in Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(tmap)

# Load in Night Lights data
# Read in each .tif for each date
night_feb_07_h5 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif"
))
night_feb_07_h6 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif"
))
night_feb_16_h5 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif"
))
night_feb_16_h6 <- read_stars(here(
  "data",
  "VNP46A1",
  "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif"
))

# Combine the two tiles for each date
night_lights_feb_07 <- st_mosaic(night_feb_07_h5, night_feb_07_h6)
night_lights_feb_16 <- st_mosaic(night_feb_16_h5, night_feb_16_h6)


# Load in Roads data
# SQL query to select only motorway
roads_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"

# Load in Roads data with query
highway <- st_read(
  here("data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = roads_query,
  quiet = TRUE # ignore warning message
)

# Load in Houses data
# SQL query to select only residential buildings
houses_query <- "SELECT *
                 FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
                 WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
                 OR type IN ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"

# Load in Houses data with query
houses <- st_read(
  here("data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = houses_query,
  quiet = TRUE # ignore warning message
)
```



#### Transform Data to Match CRSs
```{r}
# Transform CRSs
highway <- st_transform(highway, crs = "EPSG:3083")
houses <- st_transform(houses, crs = "EPSG:3083")


# Run conditional to make sure transform worked
if (st_crs(highway) != st_crs(houses)) {
  warning(
    "Highways and houses have different CRS"
  )
}

# Verify CRSs match
st_crs(highway) == st_crs(houses)
```



## Create Blackout Mask
```{r}
# Create new raster objects
pre_storm <- night_lights_feb_07
post_storm <- night_lights_feb_16

# Calculate difference (change) in night light intensity
light_diff <- pre_storm - post_storm

# Verify the difference contains increase and decrease
if (
    !(any(light_diff[[1]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) &
        any(light_diff[[1]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE))
) {
    warning(
        "Raster calculating the difference does not contain both positive and negative values"
    )
}
```


#### Reclassify the cells
```{r}
# Reclassify the cells and drop any less than 200 nW cm⁻²sr⁻¹
blackout_mask <- light_diff
blackout_mask[blackout_mask < 200] <- NA

# Verify it worked and is not empty
if (all(is.na(blackout_mask[[1]]))) {
  stop("Blackout mask is empty and no cells exceed the determined threshold")
}
```


#### Vectorize the mask 
```{r}
blackout_vector <- st_as_sf(blackout_mask) |>
  st_make_valid()
```


#### Crop the vectorized raster to Houston
```{r}
# Make the area (Houston) a polygon

# Create the bbox extent of Houston
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
  crs = st_crs(blackout_vector)
)

houston_blackout <- st_crop(blackout_vector, houston_bbox)
```


#### Reproject and Verify the CRS of the Datasets
```{r}
# Reproject to proper EPSG (EPSD:3083)
houston_blackout <- st_transform(houston_blackout, crs = "EPSG:3083")

# Run check to make sure houses matches houston CRS
if (st_crs(houston_blackout) != st_crs(houses)) {
  stop("Update CRSs so they match!")
}

# Run check to make sure highways matches houston CRS
if (st_crs(houston_blackout) != st_crs(highway)) {
  stop("Update CRSs so they match!")
}

# Verify
st_crs(houston_blackout) == st_crs(houses)
st_crs(houston_blackout) == st_crs(highway)
```



## Exclude Highways from the Cropped Blackout Mask
```{r}
# Create a 200m buffer around highways
highway_buffer <- st_buffer(highway, dist = 200)

# Use union to combine geometries
highway_union <- st_union(highway_buffer)

# Remove areas further away from 200 meters from highways
blackout_no_highways <- houston_blackout |>
  st_filter(y = highway_union, .predicate = st_disjoint)
```



## Identify Homes Likely Impacted by Blackouts
```{r}
# Filter the houses that relate to blackout area
houses_blackout <- houses |>
  st_filter(blackout_no_highways)

# Print the houses affected by blackout
n_houses <- nrow(houses_blackout)
```

There were approximately 139,146 houses that were affected by the blackout.

## Map the Affected Areas

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +

  tm_shape(houses) +

  tm_dots(fill = "dodgerblue", size = 0.02) +

  tm_shape(highway) +

  tm_lines(col = "darkgoldenrod1", lwd = 0.8) +

  tm_shape(houses_blackout) +

  tm_dots(fill = "red1", size = 0.02) +

  tm_add_legend(
    type = "symbols",
    labels = c("Did not lose power", "Lost power"),
    title = "Homes",
    fill = c("dodgerblue", "red1")
  ) +

  tm_add_legend(
    type = "lines",
    labels = "Highway",
    col = "darkgoldenrod1"
  ) +

  tm_title("Houston Homes That Lost Power, Feb 2021 Winter Storms") +

  tm_layout(
    legend.position = tm_pos_out("right", "center"),
    legend.frame = TRUE
  ) +

  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom"), text.size = 0.5) +

  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top"), size = 1.5)
```
